text: Everforest for the Harness web interface 是一款面向 Harness 网页客户端的配色主题插件，通过浏览器端主题模块将 Everforest 色彩覆盖到界面主题 token，并在 Settings → General 注册配色选择项。它提供 hard、medium、soft 三种深度，每种都有浅色和深色方案；选择后会同步设置 Harness 的外观偏好，也可恢复内置配色。所选深度保存在当前浏览器的 localStorage，默认使用 medium。适合希望调整 Harness 网页界面颜色与对比度的用户；无需 API Key 或外部账号。

Everforest for the Harness web interface themes the Harness web client with Everforest colors and a picker under Settings → General. Choose hard, medium, or soft in light or dark, or restore the built-in palette. Your depth is saved in this browser; no API key or account is required.
想给 Harness 网页换成 Everforest 风格的配色。
Can I choose a softer or higher-contrast color theme for the Harness web UI?
Everforest for the Harness web interface 的功能「配色选择」：在 Settings → General 选择三种深度和浅色或深色方案，也可恢复内置配色；深度保存在当前浏览器。

@local/dsh-theme-everforest README · Everforest for the Harness web interface：The pack ships six [Everforest](https://github.com/sainnhe/everforest) palettes for the Harness web interface. Each palette pairs a depth with a light or dark plane.
section: Everforest for the Harness web interface

text:
@local/dsh-theme-everforest README · Features：- 🌿 **Upstream colors**: every color comes from Everforest.
- 🌓 **Six palettes**: hard, medium and soft, each in light and dark.
- 🎨 **All surfaces**: all 154 base tokens get Everforest colors.
- ⌨️ **Syntax included**: code blocks use Everforest highlight groups.
- 🧩 **No setup**: the pack has no dependencies, install scripts or host configuration.

@local/dsh-theme-everforest README · Palettes：The depth sets contrast against the canvas. The plane selects the light or dark half.

| Depth | Light | Dark |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Hard |  |  |
| Medium |  |  |
| Soft |  |  |

Medium is the default. Hard has the highest text contrast. Soft has the lowest.

@local/dsh-theme-everforest README · Install：Install the bundle from a Harness session with the plugin manager:

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle
  target: /path/to/dsh-theme-everforest
```

The target is the absolute path of a clone of this repository. You can also install from the Plugin Manager page. Point that page at the same directory.

Reload the page after the first install. Open Settings → General → Everforest and select a depth.

@local/dsh-theme-everforest README · Choose a palette：The Settings row offers seven choices. Each choice sets the depth and the host theme preference.

| Choice | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| Default | Removes the Everforest layer and restores the built-in palette. |
| Dark Hard, Dark Medium, Dark Soft | Applies a dark plane and sets Appearance to Dark. |
| Light Hard, Light Medium, Light Soft | Applies a light plane and sets Appearance to Light. |

The depth stays in this browser and defaults to `medium`.
@local/dsh-theme-everforest README · Choose a palette：The three Appearance choices keep working on their own. Select System with a depth. The page then follows the system light or dark setting.

@local/dsh-theme-everforest README · Known limits：- **First paint**: the Harness boot stylesheet paints the default background before Everforest loads. This flash is cosmetic and unavoidable for a per-browser choice.
- **Defaults, not overrides**: components with deeper selectors keep their color. One example is the Plugin Manager destructive button.
- **Untouched properties**: `--dsw-focus-ring-color`, shadows, radii and fonts stay unchanged. Two static neutral tokens stay white for translucent highlights.
- **Per-browser depth**: the depth lives in this browser origin. It does not sync through the profile.
